tasks.title: Implement durable task registry and validation
acceptance_criteria: Task schema and registry are committed
Validator checks required fields, unique IDs, dependencies and state invariants
Workflow validates and reports the queue

verification.evidence: GitHub Actions STS Work Queue Health run #27 (43510229607) passed registry validation, validator unit tests, dashboard generation, and dashboard publication on PR #829 head fd8368bcd292b52a57949134d4b01b0a24850e1f; PR #829 merged as 5599f265e2b6925f1aaabfdbea8838b4ead0b3f1. SS1 package integrity run #1741 and JSS3 implementation/asset run #3901 also passed.

tasks.title: Integrate agent-platform worker launch and recovery adapter
acceptance_criteria: Document supported agent execution platform and authentication model
Implement safe launch/resume adapter using supported API
Expired task can be requeued without duplicate workers
Adapter tests cover timeout and duplicate launch
tasks.blocker: The repository integration does not identify an agent execution platform or expose its supported launch/resume API and authentication contract. Do not invent an endpoint or wire arbitrary credentials. Provide the platform name and authorized API contract to proceed.

tasks.title: Create completion-gate dashboard from task evidence
acceptance_criteria: Summarize gate progress from task records
Distinguish verified, unverified, blocked and stalled work
Never infer completion from unchecked status
